prayerExcerpt.en-US: The glory of God is a living man; and the life of man consists in beholding God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A glória de Deus é o homem vivo, e a vida do homem é a visão de Deus.

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a long, narrow face and a high, domed forehead; a long nose with a softly rounded tip; pale grey eyes set wide apart under sparse, level ash-brown brows; smooth, flat cheeks; a long chin; a small, soft mouth; straight ash-brown hair to the ears, a long, straight ash-brown beard falling to the chest and silvering at the chin, and a gentle, peaceable gaze.
meta.basis: Portraits are traditional, not from life: the modern Orthodox icon gives him a long, straight brown beard and a long face, the Bégule window at Lyon a greying beard. Ash-brown silvering at the chin combines them and keeps him off the white-bearded elder.
meta.excerpt: Irenaeus, Against Heresies IV.20.7, ANF vol. 1 (1885), https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0103420.htm (opening "For" dropped); pt-BR our rendering
